mainEntity.name: What should I include in a custom drinkware enquiry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a model or reference, intended use, estimated quantity, artwork, packing, destination and required arrival date. If a specification is undecided, describe the use so it can be reviewed with the model.

mainEntity.name: Are the reference images and specifications the final order?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the references to discuss the project. Confirm the final material, dimensions, components, artwork and sample in the written specification before production.

mainEntity.name: How is a quote request sent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit the project details and artwork on the contact page. The receiving service confirms storage with an enquiry reference. Email forwarding is pending configuration in this preview; website receipt does not mean an email has been delivered.

/oem-manufacturer/.html:
HOME / OEM & ODM MANUFACTURING

From your brief.
To your branded product.

Customize existing drinkware and accessories, or discuss a new silicone or plastic product. Start with your drawing, reference sample or idea; agree the scope before tooling and production.

Discuss My OEM / ODM Project ↗Browse Existing Models

Silicone and plastic processing in Shenzhen · for brands, small businesses and promotional buyers serving the US market.

From 10 pcsSmall-batch customization
As fast as 1 daySampling on eligible projects
7–10 daysDoor-to-door transit, production not included
OEM / ODMExisting models to new designs

MOQ, sampling speed and delivery depend on the model, customization, destination and approval status. New tooling is assessed separately. Confirm the schedule and its start date in your quotation.

THREE ROUTES · CHOOSE BY WHAT YOU CHANGE

Not every project needs a new mold.

Most briefs start from a model that is already in production. Change the decoration only and no new mold is needed; change the shape and it has to be assessed. Pick the route by what you want to change, not by what the project is called.

01 / RESTYLE AN EXISTING MODEL

BEST FOR: A LAUNCH DATE ALREADY SET

Change the look. Keep the mold.

Start from a model that is already in production. Change the colour, logo, decoration and packing, and keep the structure that has already been proven in use.

  • What changes: colour, logo, decoration, packing
  • What stays: the existing body, lid and tooling
  • Sample approval before production
NEW TOOLING: USUALLY NOT REQUIREDExplore product models →
02 / CHANGE PART OF A MODEL

BEST FOR: STANDING OUT FROM THE CATALOGUE

Adjust one part, not the whole product.

Keep the body that already works and change the part your buyer actually notices — the lid, the handle, the straw or the capacity. Tooling is only discussed for the part you change.

  • What changes: lid, cap, handle, straw or capacity
  • Fit and seal checked on a sample
  • Part-level tooling quoted on its own
NEW TOOLING: SOMETIMES · THE CHANGED PART ONLYReview the customization options →
03 / DEVELOP A NEW PRODUCT

BEST FOR: A STRUCTURE THAT DOES NOT EXIST YET

Build the product your category is missing.

Bring a drawing, a reference sample or a described function. Feasibility, material, wall sections, assembly and tooling are reviewed before any mold is cut.

  • What changes: body, lid, drinking system, assembly
  • Drawing or sample feasibility review
  • Approved specification before tooling
NEW TOOLING: USUALLY REQUIREDDiscuss a new product →

Route visuals are development illustrations, not photographs of finished orders.

AGREE THE SCOPE FIRST

OEM or ODM? Define the work, not just the label.

Project starting pointWhat you provideWhat we review together
Existing model customizationReference model, logo, quantity and packing needsDecoration, color, components, sample and delivery
OEM: manufacture to your designDrawing or sample, material and acceptance requirementsFeasibility, tooling, tolerances, sample and production scope
ODM: development with design supportIdea, target use, references and project constraintsAvailable design support, specification, development scope and costs

Confirm design deliverables, tooling ownership, confidentiality, costs and any externally arranged work in the project agreement.

CUSTOMIZATION, BUILT AROUND YOUR BRIEF

More than a logo on a cup.

Match the decoration and components to the material, surface, use and budget.

Screen & UV printing

Silkscreen, pad print or full-wrap UV on a straight or tapered wall. A digital proof on your actual model comes back before anything is printed.

From 10 pcs · proof in 1–2 days

Laser decoration

A permanent mark cut into the surface, no ink to wear off. Best on solid hard plastic; not on soft silicone, and not across a seam.

Tritan and hard plastic

LED configuration

Base-lit, water-activated or switch. The module is chosen for the cup you pick, and we film the light before the run starts.

CR2032 or sealed module

Material & color

Silicone, Tritan, PP and AS — matched to your Pantone number, not to a photograph of a swatch book.

Pantone matching

Artwork & decoration

Heat transfer, water transfer, in-mould labels and pad print. We tell you which one actually holds on your shape.

Vector file preferred

Custom packaging

Gift box, kraft sleeve, printed insert, barcode and marketplace-ready labelling. Packed to arrive intact, not to look good in a photo.

Retail, gift and e-commerce

IN THE FIELD

Already on tables we never saw.

Our own models, composited into licensed event photography. The cup and the finish are files you can order — the room is a licensed photograph, the image is a composite, not an event we attended.

Scene photography licensed from Pexels and Unsplash. Cups are our models composited into licensed scenes, not photographs of an actual order.

FROM BRIEF TO DELIVERY

A clear path to your custom order.

Nine delays out of ten start in step one. What you send there decides how fast the rest goes — so each step below says what we need and what comes back.

01

Share your brief

Product or idea, quantity, artwork and destination.

You sendA model number or a use case, target quantity, artwork if you have it, destination ZIP and the date you need it.We returnA written list of what is still missing, plus a first indication of route and minimum quantity — usually within one working day.
02

Review & quote

Agree materials, customization and any tooling.

You sendMaterial and colour choice, decoration method, packaging, and whether tooling is in scope.We returnUnit price by quantity break, tooling cost if any, and the schedule with the date it starts.
03

Approve a sample

Approve the specification, artwork and sample.

You sendOne written approval covering the artwork version, the colour reference and the sample itself.We returnA sample made to the final specification, plus photographs of the exact unit we keep on file.
04

Produce & inspect

Follow the agreed acceptance and packing requirements.

You sendYour acceptance criteria — an AQL level or your own checklist — and the packing specification.We returnProduction status, an inspection report measured against those criteria, and photos of the packed cartons.
05

Arrange delivery

Confirm shipping scope, destination and arrival plan.

You sendConsignee address, import details, and whether you want door-to-door or delivery to your forwarder.We returnShipping documents, tracking, and the date the goods actually left.

BEFORE THE NUMBER

What decides the price and the schedule.

Two enquiries that look the same can come back with different numbers. These four points are usually what moves them.

  • 01 · ToolingA new mold for a body, lid or component is a one-off cost with its own schedule. Reusing an existing mold takes it out of the quotation entirely.
  • 02 · Part count and fitMore parts mean more assembly, more fit checks and more ways for a first sample to come back wrong.
  • 03 · Decoration and finishNumber of print positions, colour count, coverage, laser area, coating and multi-side artwork each add setup and inspection steps.
  • 04 · Sampling rounds and approvalsEvery extra revision round adds time. Approving artwork, colour and sample version together is the fastest route.

TYPICAL SCHEDULE

1–2 daysExisting sample
usually 3–5 days after drawing approvalCustomised sample
30–40 daysNew tooling, drawing to first sample
25–30 daysMass production, standard run
Sampling
Samples are usually completed 3–5 days after drawing approval. A fully customised sample — colour matching, a new structure or a multi-part set — is usually completed 3–5 days after drawing approval.
New tooling
30–40 days end to end. Machining one version of the mold is about 3–4 weeks of that — the rest is scheduling, trial shots and your approval on the first sample.
Production
25–30 days for a standard run. Custom work runs longer: colour matching, special inks, multi-part sets and a first batch off a brand-new mold all add time on top. Inside a standard run the moulding stage is 5–10 days for Tritan and silicone cups, around 20 days for the LED range.

The figures for your project are written into the quotation, including the date the schedule starts and what would change it.

A REAL PROJECT · YACHT EVENT, CALIFORNIA

One brief. A reviewed sample. Cups at the event.

The first request was a logo on a plastic cup. Artwork and sample reviews led to a 16 oz cold colour-changing silicone cup. These three scenes follow that same project from the initial idea to sample approval and event use.

6Design revisions
3Physical sample rounds
3Details agreed on the sample
20 daysThis project: expedited door to door
01 / THE INITIAL IDEA

Start with the logo and the cup.

The event date was fixed; the cup and production artwork were still open. The starting discussion was how to place the logo on a plastic cup.

02 / THE SAMPLE DECISION

A silicone sample replaces the plastic-cup idea.

Six revisions and three sample rounds led to a 16 oz cold colour-changing silicone cup. Three detail changes were agreed using the physical sample.

03 / READY FOR THE EVENT

The same custom cup, now on the yacht.

The approved sample guided a 150-piece trial order, packing and expedited delivery to California. This project took twenty days from approval to the client’s hands.

A real project with client details withheld. These are process illustrations with a stand-in emblem, not order photographs. Twenty days was this project’s actual timeline; other orders are confirmed individually.

MANUFACTURING & PROJECT CONTROL

Make every approval specific.

Silicone and plastic processing by BOOM Drinkware Review the production and supply scope for your selected product.

  • Material & specificationRecord dimensions, components and intended use.
  • Artwork & sample approvalAgree the sample version and decoration before production.
  • Inspection & packing requirementsDefine acceptance points and project documents.
Review Factory & Supply Scope →

PAPER, NOT ADJECTIVES

Every claim here has a file behind it.

Eleven documents are on record: two management-system certificates, two granted patents, finished-product tests and reports on the resins we buy. Ask which one covers your model and we send that scan, not a badge.

ISO 9001:2015Quality management · cert. 80682025Q1503R05 · valid to 10 Dec 2028
ISO 14001:2015Environmental management · cert. 80682025E0828R05 · valid to 10 Dec 2028
Utility model patentDetachable wine glass · ZL 2022 2 1579532.1 · granted 10 Jan 2023
FDA / SGS reportFinished champagne flute · food-contact migration test

Held by Shenzhen Hongrun New Material Technology Co., Ltd., our affiliated plant for moulded and blow-moulded drinkware. Click any file to read the scan, including the certificate number and the scope. See all 11 files →

BEFORE YOU REQUEST A QUOTE

Start with what you know.

Can I start with 10 pieces?

Small-batch customization starts from 10 pieces on eligible configurations. Share the model, number of designs and packaging requirements; custom tooling and special specifications are reviewed separately.

Does one-day sampling apply to a new mold?

Sampling can be as fast as one day for eligible projects. New molds, new structures and complex decoration require a separate assessment. Confirm sample type, artwork approval and timing in the quote.

What does 7–10 day door-to-door delivery include?

The 7–10 days is transit only, counted from the day your goods are packed and handed to the carrier. Production is not included: a standard run takes 25–30 days ex-works, and new tooling takes 30–40 days end to end. Plan production and shipping as two separate blocks when you set a launch date.

Can I enquire without a model or drawing?

Yes. Describe the intended use, approximate quantity and required arrival date. You can add a reference image or artwork on the existing enquiry form.

BEFORE YOU ASK FOR A PRICE

Eight details that make the first quote usable.

You do not need all of them to send an enquiry. Missing items come back as open questions instead of being guessed.

  • Product or modelA model code, a photo, or a short description of what it holds.
  • QuantityTotal pieces, and how many designs or colours sit inside that total.
  • ArtworkLogo file, how many positions it prints on, and the colours available.
  • Use and materialHot or cold, indoor or outdoor, one event or a reusable range.
  • CapacityThe volume you need, and whether it can move.
  • PackingPoly bag, gift box, insert card or carton marks.
  • DestinationCountry and postcode, so freight is quoted with the goods.
  • Arrival dateThe date the goods must be in hand, not the date you place the order.

Send what you have. The rest is listed as open points in the reply.  Send these in the project enquiry →

LET’S BUILD YOUR NEXT PRODUCT

Have a model, a drawing—or just an idea?

Send your quantity, artwork, destination and arrival date. Start with the details you have; add files in the project enquiry.

Request a Quote ↗Browse Products

No model selected? Describe your project in the requirements field.

Illustrative visuals are clearly labeled. Product details, samples and project terms are approved for your order.

/zh/oem-manufacturer/.html:
首页 / OEM 与 ODM 定制制造

从你的需求，
到品牌定制产品。

定制现有杯具与配件，或沟通硅胶、塑胶新产品开发。从图纸、参考样或想法开始，在开模与生产前确认项目范围。

沟通我的 OEM / ODM 项目 ↗浏览现有型号

在深圳开展硅胶与塑胶加工 · 服务美国市场的品牌、中小企业及活动礼品采购。

10 件起小批量定制
最快 1 天适用项目快速打样
7–10 天只算运输段，不含生产
OEM / ODM现有款定制与新设计开发

起订量、打样和配送时效取决于型号、定制内容、目的地及确认进度；新开模项目单独评估。具体周期及起算点以项目报价确认为准。

三种开发路线 · 按改动多少来选

不是每个项目都要开新模。

大部分项目都从已经量产的型号开始。只改外观和印刷，不需要开新模；改结构，才要单独评估。按你想改的地方选路线，而不是按项目叫什么名字选。

01 / 现有型号换装

适合：档期已经定死的项目

改外观，不动模具。

从已经量产的型号开始。改颜色、Logo、表面工艺和包装，保留已经在实际使用中验证过的结构。

  • 要改的：颜色、Logo、工艺、包装
  • 不动的：现有杯身、盖子与模具
  • 生产前确认样品
开新模：通常不需要看现有型号 →
02 / 只改型号的一个件

适合：想在同类里做出差别

只调一个件，不动整只产品。

保留已经好用的杯身，改客户真正看得见的那一个件 —— 盖子、手柄、吸管或容量。只有改到的那个件才需要谈开模。

  • 要改的：盖子、手柄、吸管或容量
  • 配合度与密封性在样品上验证
  • 改件的模具单独报价
开新模：可能要 · 只针对改动的那一个件看定制选项 →
03 / 开发全新产品

适合：市面上还没有的结构

做你这个品类缺的那只产品。

图纸、参考样，或只描述功能都可以。可行性、材料、壁厚、装配和开模方式，在开模之前先评估清楚。

  • 要改的：杯身、盖子、饮水结构、装配
  • 图纸或样品的可行性评估
  • 开模前先定版规格
开新模：通常需要谈一款新产品 →

路线配图为开发示意图，不是实际订单照片。

先确定项目范围

先说清要做什么，再确认合作方式。

项目起点你提供什么共同评估什么
现有款定制参考型号、Logo、数量及包装需求装饰、颜色、配件、样品与交付
OEM：按你的设计制造图纸或样品、材料及验收要求可行性、模具、公差、样品及生产范围
ODM：协作设计开发想法、目标用途、参考资料与项目限制可提供的设计支持、规格、开发范围与费用

设计交付物、模具归属、保密安排、费用及外协环节需在项目中明确约定。

围绕项目需求定制

从 Logo 到完整产品呈现。

结合材料、表面、用途与预算，选择合适工艺和配置。

丝印与 UV 印刷

直身或锥形杯壁都能做：丝印、移印、满版 UV。印之前先在你选定的那只杯上出电子稿。

10 件起 · 1–2 天出稿

激光刻字

把标记直接刻进表面，没有油墨可掉。适合实色硬料；软硅胶和拼缝处不适合。

Tritan 与硬质塑料

LED 配置

杯底发光、遇水触发或开关式。模块按你选的杯型配，量产前先拍视频给你看发光效果。

CR2032 或密封模块

材料与配色

硅胶、Tritan、PP、AS，按你的潘通色号配，不按色卡照片配。

支持潘通对色

图案与装饰

热转印、水转印、模内标、移印。哪一种在你这个形状上真的不掉，我们直接告诉你。

建议提供矢量文件

定制包装

礼盒、牛皮纸套、印刷内衬、条码与平台标签。按「到手不坏」来包，不按「拍照好看」来包。

零售、礼品、电商装

真实场合

已经在你看不见的桌上。

这些是我们自己的款，合成在有授权的活动摄影里。杯型和表面处理都是你能下单的那几款——房间是买过授权的照片，杯子是我们的模型文件；图是合成的，不是我们参加过的现场。

场景摄影来自 Pexels 与 Unsplash 的免费商用授权。杯子是我们的款合成进场景，不是订单实拍。

从需求到交付

清晰推进每一步定制。

十个拖期里，九个卡在第一步。你在这一步给的东西，决定后面有多快——所以每一步都写清：我们要什么、你会拿回什么。

01

提交需求

产品或想法、数量、图稿与目的地。

你给型号或使用场景、目标数量、有图就给图、收货邮编、要货日期。我们返一份还缺什么的清单，以及大致路线和起订量——通常一个工作日内。
02

评估与报价

确认材料、定制内容及模具需求。

你给材料与颜色、装饰方式、包装，以及这一单要不要开模。我们返按数量分档的单价、开模费（如有），以及排期和起算日。
03

样品确认

审核规格、图稿与实物样。

你给一次书面确认，把图稿版本、颜色参照和样品一起确认掉。我们返一只按最终规格做的样，以及留在档案里的那只的照片。
04

生产与检验

按确认的验收与包装要求推进。

你给验收标准——AQL 或你自己的清单——以及包装规格。我们返生产进度、按这套标准出的验货报告，以及装箱照片。
05

安排出货

确认运输范围、目的地与到货计划。

你给收货地址、清关资料，以及要门到门还是送到你的货代。我们返出货文件、运单号，以及实际离厂日期。

报价之前

价格和交期，由这四件事决定。

两封看起来一样的询价，回来的价格可能差一倍。通常是这四点在动。

  • 01 · 要不要开模杯身、盖子或配件开新模，是一次性投入，还要单独排期。沿用现有模具，这一项就不存在。
  • 02 · 零件数量与配合零件越多，装配越多、要验的配合越多，第一次打样出错的可能也越多。
  • 03 · 工艺与表面处理印几个面、几个色、盖色面积多大、镭雕范围、要不要加涂层，每一项都增加调机与检验的工步。
  • 04 · 打样轮次与确认速度多改一轮就多一轮时间。把图案、颜色、样品版本一次确认清楚，是最快的走法。

常规排期

1–2 天现有样品
通常在图纸确认后3–5天制作完成定制打样
30–40 天新开模，确认图纸到首样
25–30 天常规大货，出货就绪
打样

询价前常见问题

从已知需求开始即可。

可以从 10 件开始吗？

适用配置可从 10 件小批量定制开始。请提供型号、设计数量和包装需求；新开模及特殊规格单独评估。

新开模项目的样品时间如何确认？

样品通常在图纸确认后3–5天制作完成。新开模项目的模具环节及整体排期另行确认。

7–10 天门到门包含哪些环节？

7–10 天只算运输段——从货打包完成交到承运人那天起算，不含生产。常规大货出厂约 25–30 天，新开模整段 30–40 天。排上市时间时，生产和运输分两段算。

没有型号或图纸也能询价吗？

可以。说明用途、预计数量及期望到货日期即可，也可在现有询价表单中添加参考图片或图稿。
